legal.title: Cookie Policy
legal.intro: This policy explains the limited technologies currently used to deliver and protect the website.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small files that a website may place on a device. Similar technologies, such as local storage, may also remember a limited preference in a browser.

sections.title: What this website currently uses
paragraphs: The current version of The Hair Narrative uses only technologies that are strictly necessary to:
Some of these functions may be provided by the website’s hosting or security infrastructure.
bullets: Maintain basic security and technical stability.
Remember a language preference, where that preference is enabled.

sections.title: What this website does not use
paragraphs: The current site does not intentionally set:
Because no optional cookies are currently enabled, the site does not presently offer a separate cookie-preference panel.
bullets: Cookies used to build advertising profiles.

sections.title: Technical logs
paragraphs: Hosting or security services may generate essential request logs. These logs are not advertising cookies and are used only to deliver, troubleshoot and protect the website.

sections.title: Browser controls
paragraphs: You can inspect, delete or block cookies and local storage through your browser settings. Blocking technologies that are strictly necessary may affect language preferences or basic site operation.

sections.title: Future changes
paragraphs: If analytics, embedded media, advertising, payments or other optional technologies are added, this policy and the appropriate consent controls will be updated before those technologies are used where consent is required.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy may be sent to: hello@thehairnarrative.com

legal.review: Preliminary editorial copy. Professional legal review is required before publication.
